title: Elm House
subtitle: 互助关爱 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 互助关爱（社会服务与人际沟通·互助与关爱）
meta: 主题语境：互助关爱（社会服务与人际沟通·互助与关爱）　|　核心词汇：view　|　正文 390 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 view 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: Everybody in our street had an opinion about Elm House, the care home on the corner, and not one of them had been inside it. ① In my view that is the ordinary condition of most opinions. I went in for the first time at fifteen, carrying a bag of apples and a great deal of reluctance.

The building disappointed me at once. There was nothing to see: a corridor, eleven doors, and a small garden with a high wall. A month later we were allowed to ② view two empty rooms upstairs with my mother, who was thinking about my grandmother. From the landing you get a fine ③ view of the car park and, if you press your face to the glass, a slice of the hills comes into ④ view. A view from a window, I have since decided, is not nothing.

⑤ In view of his failing eyesight he had stopped reading, so we read to him instead: the newspaper first, then whatever he asked for, which was usually poetry. What he wanted was not company alone. He wanted to be ⑥ viewed as somebody who still had opinions, and he had plenty, mostly about the food. Mr Ho, whose room was beside that window, said his view improves every year because the trees keep growing.

My grandmother's friends believed that care homes are places where families abandon people, and for years I ⑦ viewed the matter exactly as they did. Then I spent one afternoon watching a young nurse help a woman eat, slowly, for forty minutes, without once looking at the clock. I do not think anyone who saw that could keep the old view for a single minute.

I have gone back most Saturdays since, and my own ⑧ view of old age has changed in one specific way: I no longer think the question is whether people are looked after, but whether anybody still asks them what they think. Everybody behind those eleven doors has a ⑨ view worth hearing, even the man who never speaks at all. New helpers arrive with the same reluctant face I must have had at fifteen, which always reminds me how worthless my own opinions were before I had any experience at all. Last month our district office put our short report ⑩ on view in the library, with a view to finding more young volunteers.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: C. n. 视野；视线（come into view 出现／进入视野）
D. v. 看待；视为（view sb as）
F. 固定搭配：in view of 鉴于；考虑到
G. 固定搭配：in one's view / point of view 依某人看
H. 固定搭配：on view 展出；with a view to doing 为了……起见

items.q: In my view that is the ordinary condition
we were allowed to view two empty rooms upstairs
you get a fine view of the car park
a slice of the hills comes into view
In view of his failing eyesight
to be viewed as somebody who still had opinions
I viewed the matter exactly as they did
my own view of old age has changed
Everybody behind those eleven doors has a view worth hearing
on view in the library, with a view to finding

answers.why: in my view 意为“依我看”，引出作者对街坊们那些看法的评价。
view＋宾语 two empty rooms，是动词“查看、看房”，陪同母亲去看养老院的房间。
a fine view of＋地点，指从窗口看到的“景色”，与 car park、hills 相配。
come into view 意为“映入眼帘、出现在视野中”，此处指贴在玻璃上才能看见一小片山。
in view of＋原因，意为“鉴于、考虑到”，此处说他视力衰退，于是改为读书给他听。
be viewed as＋身份，是动词“被视为”，他希望别人仍把他当个有主见的人。
view sth as ... 同样是动词“看待”，作者过去跟风用同样的眼光看养老院。
my own view of old age 指作者对老年的“看法”发生改变。
a view worth hearing 指值得倾听的“看法”，连从不说话的老人也有自己的意见。
on view 意为“展出”，with a view to doing 意为“目的在于”，此处报告被公开展出以招募志愿者。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 依我看，那是大多数看法的常态。（in my view）
从二楼能看到一片很好的山景。（view n.）
考虑到他视力衰退，我们就读书给他听。（in view of）
他希望被看成仍然有主见的人。（view sb as）
从那以后，我对老年生活的看法改变了。（view of）
那份报告被放在图书馆展出，以招募更多志愿者。（on view / with a view to）
answers: In my view, that is the ordinary condition of most opinions.
From the second floor you get a fine view of the hills.
In view of his failing eyesight, we read to him instead.
He wanted to be viewed as somebody who still had opinions.
Since then my view of old age has changed.
The report was put on view in the library with a view to recruiting more volunteers.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 view 的 3 种不同用法；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In my view, most opinions about Elm House came from people who had never been inside it.
The only view from the second floor was of a car park, though Mr Ho said the trees improved it every year.
In view of his failing eyesight we read the newspaper and a little poetry to him twice a week.
He wanted to be viewed as somebody who still had opinions, and he had plenty, mostly about the food.
After watching a young nurse feed one woman for forty minutes without looking at the clock, I could not keep my old view.
Our district office has now put our report on view in the library, with a view to finding more young volunteers.
